candidates.description: This vector represents Chinese proper nouns, specifically major cities and common phonetic components of Chinese names.
This feature vector represents prominent proper nouns referring to major political figures, global leaders, and influential multinational technology corporations.
This feature vector represents infectious diseases and medical pathogens, with a primary focus on viral illnesses like COVID-19 and coronavirus.
This vector activates on names, abbreviations, and roots related to public health agencies, disease outbreaks, and sanitation.
This vector activates for tokens containing the letter sequence "oc" or "soc" related to social or occult terms.
This feature vector represents three-digit numerical values.
This feature vector represents integers within a typical human age range.
This vector represents suffixes or root components of Romance and Latinate verbs and nouns, particularly related to processes, endings, or proper name fragments.
These tokens represent small integers typically used in numerical sequences or counting.
This vector represents names of countries and geopolitical regions.
